en.hubeali: Anumber of our companbions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Muawiya Bin Wahab who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘They (people) are reporting from the Prophetsaww that the charity (Zakāt) is not Permissible for the rich nor for the one with strong resources’. So Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘It is not correct for the rich’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahab who has said the following: “

I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘They narrate from the Holy prophet, “Charity (Zakat) is not lawful for the rich people, or resourceful strong ones.’” Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, said, ‘It is not proper for the rich people.’”
